obligations.statement: The product must be a compact folding stand for desk use.
The product must have three legs that fold in close to the body to achieve a narrow, compact folded configuration.
All parts must remain attached while folded.
The folding operation must not require removal of any parts or produce loose pieces.
The user must be able to open the stand by hand, following a sequence that makes sense.
The three legs must spread apart in different directions to provide a usable footprint on the desk.
Opening the stand must not cause any parts to come apart or fall off, and it must not require tools, motor, or other equipment.
Once opened, the stand must stay open on its own.
While in use, the legs must not require holding, and must not fold back, twist aside, or come off.
The stand must not exhibit unintended motion (turning, shifting, or moving in unexpected directions).
Folding must require a deliberate action by the user.
After deliberate release, the stand must fold back to the same compact shape as initially folded.
The opening and folding sequence must be repeatable, with all normal parts remaining attached and nothing needing removal.
The stand must hold a small object on a desk while the user is working.
The product must be buildable as a whole, assembled in a sensible order, and stay together during normal use.
A mechanism must be provided to allow the legs to fold and unfold while remaining attached.
The stand must have a locking mechanism to keep it open without holding.
The method of locking must be releasable by a deliberate user action.
The legs must pivot about hinged axes relative to a central body to achieve folding and spreading.

candidates.summary: Tripod stand with three legs hinged to a central hub, each leg folding via a revolute joint, with an over-center locking mechanism to keep legs open and a manual release to fold.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Mobility analysis can verify that three revolute joints provide the required degrees of freedom.

candidates.summary: Tripod stand with three legs using a central screw and nut to simultaneously fold and unfold legs via a helical pair, with a friction hold to maintain position.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Mobility analysis can verify that a single helical pair can drive all legs.
evidence_route_verdict.note2: Screw mechanism may require multiple joints; analysis needed.

candidates.summary: Tripod stand with three legs using compliant flexures to allow folding without traditional hinges, with a detent to latch open.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Mobility analysis can verify that flexures provide required motion without separation.

candidates.summary: Tripod stand with three legs using a crank-slider mechanism to convert linear motion of a central slider into radial spreading of legs, with a detent to lock open.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Mobility analysis can verify that the crank-slider can drive all legs.

candidates.summary: Tripod stand with three legs using a rack and pinion to rotate legs simultaneously, with a friction hold to keep them open.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Mobility analysis can verify that rack and pinion can synchronize leg motion.

unresolved.decision: Choice of principle family for leg folding and locking mechanism
unresolved.why_open: Multiple principle families (revolute joint with over-center, screw and nut, compliant flexure, crank-slider, rack and pinion) can all satisfy the basic motion and locking requirements, and the current requirements do not differentiate them.

assumptions.statement: The stand is intended for indoor desk use only.
assumptions.why: Request mentions desk and working environment
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the request implies outdoor or other environments

assumptions.statement: The stand is to be operated manually by hand.
assumptions.why: Request explicitly says no tools, motor, or other equipment
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If powered operation was later required

assumptions.statement: The object placed on the stand is stable and does not require a complex mounting.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the object needed clamping or special interface
